status.notes: Partial labels each individual canonical contribution. Complete source coverage requires the complete qualified union, required actual performances and preserved GK/LK/topic scope; no single-goal mastery closes a union.

HB15-HB21-frames.thick: Mandatory content, terminology and process competencies within applicable course/topic

HB37-choice.authority: Official topic choices fixed in advance by Abitur-year Schwerpunktkatalog; school subject conference determines sequence within rules. No learner selection or current Schwerpunkt inferred.

scopeRulesExact.skillpilotTargetPolicy: PO may include all authored applicable topics in broader target. This does not convert official choices or thin-frame suggestions into universal curriculum duties, and does not establish persisted learner selection.
scopeRulesExact.courseDimensions: Original in-table LK markers and overall p37 topic applicability are independent.
